sentences.text:
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.23/2023, dated 20.01.2023 registered at Police Station-Obedullaganj,
District-Raisen (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 04.09.2023.
2.

As per the prosecution case, on 20.01.2023, Ramsingh and Shabbo Bai r/o Village Chota Kheda,
Kollar Road, Bhopal, moved an application before S.P. Raisen alleging that Mohd. Gufran and his father Mohd. Suleman have prepared forged document of agricultural land of joint account No.55/1/1 of complainant and his sister, situated at Village Reselpur, Tehsil Goharganj, District Raisen.
It was alleged that they never put any thumb impression on any paper.

The accused persons Mohammad Gufran vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119734684/
1 wanted to deprive them from their land by preparing forged document.

sentences.text: In the investigation, it was found that in the documents filed by the accused persons, the complainants had not put their thumb impression and documents are fake and forged.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in detention since 04.09.2023.
He has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that 'Q/2' thumb impression has not been found that of Sabbo Bai, but 'Q/1' thumb impression on the application filed before the Collector was of Ram Singh.
Therefore, possibility of filing the application by Ram Singh with some other lady cannot be ruled out.
It is further submitted that even if it is found that agreement or any other document was forged by the present applicant, even then same is case of civil dispute.

After investigation,
charge-sheet has been filed.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.

4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that all documents prepared by applicant Mohammad Gufran have been found to be forged & fake documents.
Therefore, applicant may not be released on bail.
5. In this case after investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that final conclusion of trial will take considerable time, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Mohammad Gufran be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Mohammad Gufran vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119734684/
